From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Governed runtime launch — ops checklist & SLO confirmation

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Below is the minimum runbook and SLO confirmations we need from Lumina ahead of the scheduled cutover on Nov 20. Please review and reply with any concerns by EOD Monday (Nov 16) so we can lock the plan.

Key asks (high level):
- Confirm primary cutover window: 11/20, 10:00–12:00 PT (we'll reserve rollback slot 12:00–12:30)
- Approve schema contract (attached) for structured outputs and tool-call payloads
- Provide final list of whitelisted outbound tool endpoints (for function/tool-calling)
- Confirm SOC2 evidence request timeline (we requested attestation; see attachment)
- Point person for cutover: Priya (ops), backup: Sanjay

Runbook highlights (attached: launch_checklist_v2.xlsx):
1) Pre-cutover: final test against staging with 10k tokens/day replay, schema contract validation, KV cache seeding
2) Cutover: route prod traffic to dedicated pool (30-minute ramp, 10% -> 50% -> 100%), monitor token latency and 95th percentile
3) Post-cutover: 2-hour watch with on-call ENG + CS console monitoring, rollback criteria enumerated in sheet

SLO targets for this launch:
- 95th percentile first-token latency < 400ms
- Error rate < 0.5% for generation API calls
- Schema validation pass rate > 99% for structured outputs

Attachments: launch_checklist_v2.xlsx, schema_contract_v1.json, soc2_attestation.pdf (stubs)

If anything here conflicts with your internal change window or procurement approvals, flag it and we'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Monica — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick notes: 

- Cutover window Nov 20 10:00–12:00 PT looks good but we need to push a quick internal dependency check with our data export team (will confirm by EOD Nov 17).
- Schema: Priya flagged two optional fields in schema_contract_v1.json that would break an internal validator. Can you confirm if Redwood will tolerate missing values for `patient.metadata.ref_source`? If not, we need a compatibility shim.
- SOC2 attestation receipt confirmed; we'll share additional evidence by Nov 18 per your timeline.

Also please share the DocuSign for the committed reserved capacity change — Ben, can you ping procurement with updated terms?

—Sanjay

Hi all — engineering confirmations and a few tech notes: 

1) Schema tolerance: Redwood runtime can accept missing `patient.metadata.ref_source` if Lumina enables `lenient_schema` flag on the route. We recommend enabling that for the first 72 hours post-cutover while we monitor validation errors. We'll add a migration notice in the logs when data falls back to lenient mode.
2) Tool-calling endpoints: we reviewed the outbound whitelist. Please ensure the endpoints support TLS1.2+ and have a certificate chain trusted by LetsEncrypt/Commercial CA.
3) KV cache pre-seeding: we can seed common prefixes but need a list of ~200 canonical prefixes from Lumina to avoid miss rates.

I've uploaded the minimal compatibility shim (schema_compat_v1.patch) into the runbook folder and left inline notes in schema_contract_v1.json (see comments). Karthik will be on-call during cutover.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
